decisions.reason: As a newly launched multi-model product line close to the firm’s core modular lighting offer and publicly presented on its own page in a growing market, it is likely to be retained because the firm has already invested in it and can plausibly expect results to improve with time.

As a core-adjacent ceiling luminaire line with visible market presentation and fit to the firm’s design-led, sustainable growth path, management is likely to continue backing it rather than withdraw it after only a short time without clear evidence of failure.
